# Sai Samarth Tours

> Sai Samarth Tours is a trusted pilgrimage tour operator and full-service travel agency based in Yelahanka, Bangalore, Karnataka, India. We specialize in verified flight and luxury coach pilgrimages, senior-citizen-friendly yatras, domestic holidays, and international tour packages with VIP darshan, handpicked 3-star AC hotels, and pure vegetarian meals.

## Core Travel Offerings

- [All Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/tour-packages): Complete catalog of domestic, international, and spiritual tour departures from Bangalore.
- [Pilgrimage Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/pilgrimage-tour-packages): Flagship Hindu pilgrimage circuits across India.
- [Shirdi Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/shirdi-tour-packages): Bangalore to Shirdi direct flight packages with confirmed VIP Samadhi Mandir darshan passes.
- [Bus Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/bus-packages): Deluxe pushback A/C coach pilgrimages including Pancha Bootha Yatra and Tirumala Balaji.
- [Domestic Holiday Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/domestic-tour-packages): Curated holiday itineraries to Kashmir, Kerala, Ladakh, Himachal, Rajasthan, Goa, and the Andaman Islands.
- [International Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/international-tour-packages): Handcrafted overseas vacations to Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Bali, Dubai, and the Maldives.
- [Senior Citizen Tour Packages](https://saisamarthtours.com/senior-citizen-tour-packages): Thoughtfully paced spiritual circuits with wheelchair support, ground managers, and elevator-equipped hotels.

## Flagship Tour Packages

- [Shirdi Tour Package from Bangalore](https://saisamarthtours.com/package/shirdi-tour-package-from-bangalore): Direct flight yatra with VIP Kakad Aarti and darshan.
- [Shirdi with 3 Jyotirlinga Tour Package from Bangalore](https://saisamarthtours.com/package/shirdi-with-3-jyotirlinga-tour-package-from-bangalore): Covers Bhimashankar, Trimbakeshwar, Grishneshwar, and Shirdi Sai Baba.
- [Kashi Ayodhya Prayagraj Tour Package from Bangalore](https://saisamarthtours.com/package/kashi-ayodhya-prayagraj-tour-package-from-bangalore): Sacred Uttar Pradesh heritage yatra covering Kashi Vishwanath, Ayodhya Ram Mandir, and Triveni Sangam.
- [Indore Ujjain Omkareshwar Tour Package from Bangalore](https://saisamarthtours.com/package/indore-ujjain-omkareshwar-tour-package-from-bangalore): Madhya Pradesh twin-Jyotirlinga tour with Mahakaleshwar Bhasma Aarti.
- [Panch Bootha Yatra & Tirumala Balaji Bus Tour](https://saisamarthtours.com/package/panch-bootha-yatra-tirumala-balaji-bus-tour-from-bangalore): 4N/5D deluxe coach pilgrimage across the five Shiva element temples.

## Travel Blog & Pilgrimage Guides

- [5 Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra Guide](https://saisamarthtours.com/blog/5-jyotirlingas-of-maharashtra-names-locations-timings-guide): Comprehensive guide to Trimbakeshwar, Bhimashankar, Grishneshwar, Parli Vaijnath, and Aundha Nagnath.
- [Places to Visit in Omkareshwar](https://saisamarthtours.com/blog/places-to-visit-in-omkareshwar-jyotirlinga-temple-attractions-guide): Detailed attractions and Parikrama guide for Omkareshwar and Mamleshwar.
- [Best Time to Visit Kedarnath](https://saisamarthtours.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-kedarnath-weather-temperature-things-to-do-guide): Weather, temperatures, helicopter booking, and monthly guide.
- [12 Jyotirlinga Temples in India Guide](https://saisamarthtours.com/blog/12-jyotirlinga-temples-in-india-travel-guide): Complete guide to all twelve sacred Shiva shrines.
- [Ujjain Mahakaleshwar Bhasma Aarti Guide](https://saisamarthtours.com/blog/ujjain-mahakaleshwar-bhasma-aarti-booking-darshan-guide): Timings, online booking rules, and dress codes.
